summary.text: Greg Leman is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 60, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a software engineer and small business owner who has not run for office before.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Greg Leman said he built the first real-time mapping system for 911 dispatch in 1991 and then spent twenty years in enterprise technology, including as a senior director at Oracle, and has also built and advised startups.
He said he moved to Montana in 2014, lives in Gallatin Gateway, and has served as president of his homeowners' association.
Leman said his focus is a more predictable property tax system, keeping state spending within its means, and cutting red tape for small businesses.
He also listed keeping public lands open and defending the Second Amendment among his priorities.
